summary: Iteration 14 — Dispatcher Console (/dispatch) tested end-to-end. New pytest suite /app/backend/tests/test_dispatch_console.py (14 tests, all pass): GET /api/dispatch/board RBAC (dispatcher+admin 200, driver+facility 403, unauth 401), response shape (jobs[] with facility_name/driver_name/status_since ISO, no _id leak; approved_drivers contains driver1 and excludes the unverified newdriver), assign approved driver via PUT /api/jobs/{id} {assigned_driver_id,status:'offered'} with GET persistence + board driver_name resolution, assign unverified driver -> 400 ('verification is not approved') and job untouched, offer with no driver -> 400, reassign to a second approved driver (temporarily approved newdriver via admin PUT /api/drivers/{id}/record then reverted to 'incomplete' — verified reverted), cancel of unassigned and assigned jobs -> 200 + persisted 'cancelled', invalid status -> 422, unknown job -> 404, GET /api/jobs/{id}/custody-events readable by dispatcher AND admin for a facility-posted job they neither posted nor were assigned to (no _id leak), 403 for an unrelated driver, 404 for unknown job. Full backend regression: 181 passed / 2 failed (1 = known no brute-force lockout in test_auth_hardening, 1 = test-ordering interference caused by my session-scoped cleanup, fixed by switching my fixtures to module scope; re-run of test_dispatch_console + test_driver_available_jobs + test_rbac_marketplace + test_facility_portal = 66/66 green). FRONTEND (1920x1080): dispatcher1 login -> /dispatch; all 7 columns render with correct count badges; card click opens dispatch-job-dialog with status badge, route, payout/km, driver; custody timeline renders for the delivered job (Pickup confirmed / Transit ping / Delivered + 'Received by QA Recipient (Daughter)') and 'No custody events yet.' otherwise; terminal jobs correctly hide the assign/cancel block; assign flow -> toast 'Job offered to driver', dialog closes, card reappears in Offered with driver name; cancel -> toast 'Job cancelled' and card moves to Exceptions; board polls GET /api/dispatch/board exactly 2x in 22s (10s interval OK); urgent/returned/cancelled/stale cards get red border. RBAC: driver1 navigating to /dispatch is redirected to /dashboard. Regressions verified: driver /jobs shows 6 available masked cards and Accept works (toast 'Job accepted — full addresses unlocked'), facility1 /facility renders Book Transport form + My Deliveries with trackers, admin1 /admin Control Center loads. All TEST_ jobs deleted afterwards (board back to the 5 demo jobs); newdriver verification reverted to incomplete.

minor.issue: Assign sets accepted_by = assigned_driver_id at OFFER time, so a job in status 'offered' already looks 'accepted by' that driver (it also appears in the driver's /api/jobs/my). accepted_by should only be set when the driver actually accepts.
Still no brute-force lockout (6 wrong passwords -> 401 each, correct password then succeeds). Pre-existing, unchanged from iteration 13.
CORS_ORIGINS='*' with allow_credentials=True remains invalid per spec (harmless today: Bearer-token auth, no app session cookie).

ui_bugs.issue:
React DOM nesting error in console: '
cannot be a descendant of

' — the status (a div) is rendered inside a

. Causes hydration/validation errors on every dialog open.

Toasts render top-right over the sticky dark header and completely cover the dispatcher name and the logout button (role-home-logout-btn) while visible, so logout is unclickable for ~4s after every action.

Card shows facility_name only, so multiple jobs from the same facility render as three identical 'LifeLabs Queen West' cards — a dispatcher cannot tell them apart (job title/recipient/short id not shown).
Console warning: 'Missing Description or aria-describedby for DialogContent' — add DialogDescription.

integration_issues.issue: 'Created' column is permanently empty: both POST /api/jobs and facility requests land in status 'open'/'offered', and unassigned 'open' jobs are grouped under the 'Offered' column even though no driver was ever offered them. Dispatcher cannot distinguish open-pool jobs from jobs directly offered to a driver.
dispatch-cancel-btn fires immediately with no confirmation dialog — one mis-click irreversibly cancels a live medical transport (status cannot be moved back from the Exceptions column in the UI).

issues: Red highlighting fires on 6 of 10 cards (every urgent job + anything older than the 30m stale threshold), so the alert signal is lost; consider distinct urgent vs stale styling and a legend/tooltip explaining why a card is red
No column for 'exceptions' vs 'cancelled' distinction and no filter/search — with >20 jobs the single long Offered column is hard to scan
Assign control uses a native <select> instead of the shadcn Select used elsewhere in the app
Dialog has no explicit 'Close' action other than the X; payout line shows 'undefined km' style risk when distance fields are absent (renders empty after '·')

critical_code_review_comments: server.py is now ~3090 lines — split into routers (auth, jobs, dispatch, facility, admin, payments)
dispatch_board loads up to 300 jobs with no status/date filter or pagination and re-runs every 10s per dispatcher; add server-side filtering (exclude completed >24h) before the board grows

DispatchHomePage.load() builds `headers` inline and the useCallback deps only include token with an eslint-disable — acceptable, but the 10s poll re-fetches the entire board and will clobber an open dialog's data (selected job is a stale snapshot; status/driver in the dialog do not refresh)

status_since falls back to created_at for statuses not in the map (e.g. 'offered' keeps created_at), so the age clock does not reset when a dispatcher offers a job — stale detection for 'offered' is measuring time since creation, not since offer

context_for_next_testing_agent: Dispatcher Console backend + UI is functionally correct; remaining items are cosmetic/UX (DOM nesting error, toast covering logout, ambiguous card titles, empty Created column, no cancel confirmation). Reusable suite: /app/backend/tests/test_dispatch_console.py (module-scoped cleanup so it does not leak jobs into test_driver_available_jobs — keep it that way; session-scoped cleanup caused a false failure there). Note POST /api/jobs creates status 'open', not 'created'. Board demo baseline = 5 'Medical Transport'/'Lab sample transport' jobs; delete any TEST_ jobs you create with admin DELETE /api/jobs/{id}.
rca_of_the_issue: No functional defect in the new feature. The only regression-suite failure (test_driver_available_jobs::test_only_open_or_offered_to_me) was caused by my own session-scoped cleanup leaving TEST jobs visible in driver1's queue during a later module; changing my fixtures to module scope made the full suite green, confirming product behaviour was correct.
